knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: pfSense的防火牆以規則控制流量，狀態表影響後續封包的處理。
knowledge.textEn: pfSense firewall rules control traffic while the state table affects subsequent packet handling.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 把規則允許、NAT轉換與已建立state分三層；使用合成連線到達率與生命期，估算穩態state需求而不執行壓力攻擊。
knowledge.textEn: Separate rule permission, NAT translation and established state; estimate steady-state demand from synthetic arrivals and lifetimes without traffic attacks.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 在穩態且沒有提前回收的簡化模型，平均states≈每秒新連線λ×平均生命W；尖峰與重傳需另留容量。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified steady state without early eviction, average states≈arrival rate λ×mean lifetime W; bursts and retries need separate headroom.
